about: Auto-strafe physics 28 oracle from apps/web/src/styles.ts (tools/verify/autostrafe-v28-vectors.ts; research/NATIVE-AUTOSTRAFE-V28.md). live rows: one physics 28 Auto-strafe StyleFilter in order; reset = filter.reset() before the row (row 0 too); lagView(in) then apply(cmd, {grounded, onLadder, edgeLanding}, running, nextYaw) gives out; lookFrom = the row whose view sample is recorded with this command; nextYaw null = NaN; dir/still = the filter's autoDir/still after the row. replay rows (same index): apply(out[i], pre, running, out[i+1].yaw or NaN at the end / before a reset) on a fresh filter per segment must give out back; v27 = a physics 27 filter on the same command without its computed key. cmd fields: forward, side, yaw (f32 value), pitch, buttons.

sequence.note: spawn on the ground, still mouse: no key
jump: air, still mouse: no key yet (first command after a reset moves with the live yaw)
mouse turns right (yaw falls): the key (D) goes on this command, which still moves with the old view
mouse reverses (left): A on this command, the view it moves with is still turning right
still 6: past the hold, no key
W held, turning right: W + D
S held: no assist (S and A/D as typed), the view still lags
own A while turning right: the player's key wins
turn bind +left held (bits travel with the view a tick late)
released: the last turn's bits ride on this command
a view set (teleport): 150° jump; the key comes from the old view to the new one
off the ladder, still in its grace: no assist until landing
landing (first ground tick, the jump tick): still assisted
v22 edge landing without jump: Auto-strafe reads pre.grounded only (third ground tick: no assist)
reset() (restart): the first command moves with the live yaw again
last row of a recording: no next yaw (counts as a still mouse on replay)
